title: Revenue Operations and Commercial Execution
summary: Built a governed commercial operating model that improves opportunity visibility, hand-offs, and execution discipline from lead to receivable follow-up.

projectItems.title: Zoho CRM and Business Development Lifecycle
projectItems.summary: A controlled CRM backbone for prospect intake, proposals, assignment handover, project readiness, sales orders, invoicing, and receivables follow-up.
projectItems.problemStatement: Commercial records and downstream hand-offs needed one governed source of truth instead of disconnected tracking.
projectItems.solution: Designed CRM blueprints, workflows, custom modules, dashboards, and explicit status controls across business development, project, and finance hand-offs.
projectItems.impact: Created traceable commercial execution and reported approximately 15 hours of monthly time saving across six affected users.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Demonstrates the ability to connect growth operations with delivery and financial controls.
